title: MCANet: A Multi-Scale Class-Specific Attention Network for Multi-Label Post-Hurricane Damage Assessment Using UAV Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2509.04757v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hurricanes cause widespread damage to buildings, roads, and other infrastructure, making timely post-disaster damage assessment critical for emergency response and recovery planning. Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery provides high-resolution observations of affected areas, but post-hurricane scenes are difficult to classify because multiple damage categories often co-occur within the same image, appear at different spatial scales, and include visually similar severity levels as well as rare but operationally important classes. To address these challenges, this study presents MCANet, a multi-label classification framework for post-hurricane UAV damage assessment. MCANet integrates a Res2Net-based backbone for multi-scale representation with class-specific residual attention to aggregate spatial evidence separately for each damage category. translated_title: MCANet：基于无人机图像的多尺度类别特定注意力网络用于飓风后多标签损伤评估
translated_abstract: 飓风对建筑物、道路和其他基础设施造成广泛破坏，因此及时的灾后损伤评估对应急响应和恢复规划至关重要。无人机（UAV）图像能够提供受灾区域的高分辨率观测，但飓风后的场景难以分类，原因在于多个损伤类别经常在同一图像中共存、出现在不同的空间尺度上，并且包含视觉上相似的严重程度等级以及罕见但在实际救援行动中重要的类别。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了MCANet，一个用于飓风后无人机损伤评估的多标签分类框架。MCANet集成了基于Res2Net的骨干网络以实现多尺度表示，并结合类别特定的残差注意力机制，为每个损伤类别分别聚合空间证据。该研究在RescueNet数据集上进行了评估，该数据集包含飓风后收集的4,494张无人机图像。
tldr: 提出MCANet框架，通过结合Res2Net多尺度骨干网络和类别特定残差注意力机制，解决了飓风后无人机图像多标签损伤评估中多类别共存、多尺度和视觉相似等挑战。
